content.text:
I submitted **index 21 (Sb fraction 0.624)** as the best composition. At **0.077% EQE** it was the highest of the five compositions I measured, and all 5 EQE measurements are now used.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.263 | 0.015 |
| 14 | 0.511 | 0.024 |
| 21 | 0.624 | **0.077** |
| 23 | 0.679 | 0.051 |
| 28 | 0.708 | about 0 |

EQE rises as Sb content increases, peaks around 0.62, and falls to nothing by 0.71. I measured index 21 last because it had the highest predicted value from the Gaussian-process tool; its neighbour, index 20 (Sb 0.596), had a similar prediction and is still unmeasured.

The phase explanation is a guess: the best region lies near where PbSb₂O₆ forms (Sb 0.667), and the weak middle sample sits near Pb₂Sb₂O₇ (Sb 0.5). I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so I haven't confirmed which phases are actually present.

The true peak may be slightly off index 21, most likely between 0.60 and 0.66 (indices 20 and 22).
